boards.school_name: Nebraska Methodist College of Nursing & Allied Health
boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the Dodge Street corridor near Nebraska Methodist College, each with one practical reason to stop.

cards.title: Omaha Central Library
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 72nd & Dodge
cards.notes: Use the library’s public gathering spaces and resource access for a focused off-campus change of setting; confirm programming before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A public library destination at 72nd and Dodge.
cards.evidence_claim: Omaha Central Library’s project FAQ identifies its location as 72nd and Dodge streets and describes the library as a gathering place with access to resources and training.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s official site for current hours, programs, and entry details.

cards.entity_name: Zen Coffee Co. at Central Library
cards.title: Zen Coffee Co. at Central Library
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 7205 Dodge St
cards.notes: Pair a library visit with a made-to-order drink or toast; the location lists non-caffeinated kids-flight choices alongside its regular menu.
cards.short_summary: Coffee and toast service inside the Central Library location.
cards.evidence_claim: Zen Coffee Co. lists a Central Library location at 7205 Dodge St and states that it offers coffee and toast flights, including non-caffeinated kids-flight options.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Central Library hours as Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Target Omaha
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 7200 Dodge St
cards.notes: Make this the practical stop for everyday supplies or order pickup; use the store map to locate the department you need before heading in.
cards.short_summary: A Dodge Street Target with order pickup and Drive Up.
cards.evidence_claim: Target’s official store page lists Target Omaha at 7200 Dodge St and offers Order Pickup, Drive Up, and same-day delivery.
cards.access_notes: Store hours and services are shown on Target’s location page and can change.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — near 72nd & Dodge
cards.notes: Build a burrito, bowl, tacos, salad, or quesadilla to your own preferences, then use in-store pickup if you want a faster handoff.
cards.short_summary: A customizable fast-casual meal stop near 72nd and Dodge.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s official location page places this restaurant at 201 S 72nd St near 72nd & Dodge and lists burritos, bowls, quesadillas, tacos, salads, and in-store pickup.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily restaurant hours and pickup availability; verify before departing.

cards.title: Nebraska Furniture Mart Omaha Store
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 700 S 72nd St
cards.notes: Browse furniture, flooring, appliances, or electronics in person, and use the official store directory if you are looking for a specific department.
cards.short_summary: A large retail stop for home, tech, and appliance browsing.
cards.evidence_claim: Nebraska Furniture Mart’s official Omaha store page lists its address as 700 S 72nd St and provides a store directory for furniture, flooring, appliances, and electronics.
cards.access_notes: Official store hours are posted online; NFM notes that major-holiday closures may apply.

cards.title: Five Guys Dodge St.
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 7345 Dodge St
cards.notes: Choose a burger, dog, fries, or shake and tailor the order with the restaurant’s listed customizable menu options before pickup or dine-in.
cards.short_summary: A dine-in, takeout, and delivery burger stop on Dodge.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys’ official location page lists the Dodge St. restaurant at 7345 Dodge Street and identifies dine-in, takeout, delivery, burgers, fries, shakes, and customizable options.
cards.access_notes: Check the location page for current store and delivery hours.

cards.title: Casey’s 7660 Dodge St
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 7660 Dodge St
cards.notes: Use the bakery, breakfast, pizza, sandwich, or wing options for a quick food stop, with pickup and delivery options listed by the store.
cards.short_summary: A convenience stop with prepared-food service on Dodge.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey’s official store page lists its 7660 Dodge St location and identifies bakery, breakfast, pizza, sandwiches, wings, curbside pickup, delivery, and in-store pickup.
cards.access_notes: The official store page posts current store, pickup, delivery, and fuel hours.

cards.title: Zio’s Pizzeria — 78th & Dodge
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — 7834 Dodge St
cards.notes: Plan a dine-in or takeout pizza meal at Zio’s original Omaha location; use its location page to confirm the day’s hours before you go.
cards.short_summary: Zio’s original Omaha pizzeria location on Dodge Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Zio’s official location page identifies its original Omaha location at 7834 Dodge Street, at 78th and Dodge, and states that dine-in and takeout are available.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day and holiday; refer to the official location page before visiting.

cards.title: AMC Westroads 14
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — Westroads at California St and Dodge
cards.notes: Check the current showtime list and select a film rating that fits your group; the theater page lists accessibility features and reserved seating.
cards.short_summary: A 14-screen theater at Westroads beside the Dodge corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: AMC’s official theater page lists AMC Westroads 14 at 10000 California St and identifies IMAX, reserved seating, closed captioning, assisted listening devices, and audio description.
cards.access_notes: Showtimes, film ratings, and ticket availability are posted on AMC’s official theater page.

cards.title: Westroads Mall
cards.subtitle: Dodge Street corridor — at I-680 and Dodge Street
cards.notes: Use the mall directory to identify a specific shop, food option, or theater before going, since individual tenant hours can differ from mall hours.
cards.short_summary: A multi-store destination at the Dodge Street and I-680 intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Omaha identifies Westroads Mall at the intersection of I-680 and Dodge Street and reports more than 135 specialty stores, restaurants, and a 14-screen AMC theater.
cards.access_notes: Mall hours are listed by Visit Omaha; department stores, restaurants, and theater hours may vary.
